idea-plugin.name: RefDex
idea-plugin.description:
A method-level code index for AI clients. RefDex parses your Python, TypeScript, Java and C# code into a local SQLite index and serves it over MCP, so Claude Code, Junie and GitHub Copilot can search symbols, read outlines and fetch single methods instead of opening whole files.

  • Indexes the project in the background and keeps the index up to date as files change.
  • Connects Claude Code, Junie and GitHub Copilot in one step, and copies a ready-made config for AI Assistant.
  • Offers its tools only where they pay off: on a small codebase, reading files is cheaper.

Everything runs locally; no code leaves your machine.
